v1.1:
Repos move to the app's own folder /ext/apps_data/gitphin/git (repos in /ext/git move there by themselves on the first start). The web file manager is limited to the SD card. Author contact in the description.

v1.0:
First public release. Git server on the Flipper Zero: clone, pull and push with plain git over USB (needs the Gitphin PC bridge, Linux). Web UI at localhost:8080 with code, commits, diffs, branches, tags, search, issues, pull requests, releases and wiki. Repos are normal bare repositories in /ext/git on the SD card.
